description.en:
Admin console commands to fix up a field.
Console commands: clearFertilizerState [fieldId] - clears the fertilizer ground layer setGrowthState [fieldId] <state> - sets the growth state of the dominant crop on the field (number) getGrowthState [fieldId] - shows the growth states of the crops on the field
Without a field id the field under the player is used. Only fertilizer is removed, other spray types (manure, lime, ...) are left untouched. setGrowthState only changes the existing dominant crop. In multiplayer only admins can use the changing commands and the change is applied on the server.
